fomc.why: fedpath.FOMC_DECISIONS is a FORWARD calendar starting 2026-01-28, so only a handful of decisions fall inside the price sample; and a 14:00 ET announcement post-dates the 15:00 London PM fix, so no fix window can contain it. A verified historical FOMC calendar plus a US-close gold series (GLD_PX from 2004, COMEX_GOLD_FRONT from 2016) would be required.
